subject: MAP: hosting mode decision, geo gating, and contingency for go-live
messages:
From: Ava Patel <ava.patel@mednova.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Li <sam.li@mednova.com>, procurement@mednova.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft and hosting questions ahead of MOPC

Priyom / Redwood team,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. Attached is our updated MAP (MedNova_MAP_v2.xlsx) with dates pulled forward to meet an internal board window. We have three primary asks to confirm before we lock the MOPC:

- Hosting mode for production: we currently prefer Dedicated (US-East) for data residency and predictable SLAs, but we need to understand fallbacks and pricing if we hit capacity limits.
- Compliance artifacts: our security team will need SOC2 evidence and an encrypted logging summary for vendor review.
- Procurement timeline: we need a firm SOW + pricing by 2026-06-07 to hit our legal and finance cycles.

Can Redwood propose a short evaluation plan that keeps the POC on Hosted (speed) while we qualify Dedicated for prod? Also please flag any items that would force us to consider a Private deployment.

Attachments: MedNova_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP workbook), SOC2-Audit-questions.pdf (our security questionnaire).

Best,
Ava
Ava Patel
Sr. Product Ops, MedNova Health
ava.patel@mednova.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@mednova.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and hosting questions ahead of MOPC

Ava — thanks for the MAP and the clear timelines. High level response and proposed MAP updates below. (Quoting your asks inline.)

> Hosting mode for production: we currently prefer Dedicated (US-East) for data residency and predictable SLAs, but we need to understand fallbacks and pricing if we hit capacity limits.

Recommendation: run the POC on Hosted for fastest velocity (no infra lead time) and run a parallel Dedicated validation sprint that we complete by 2026-06-21. If Dedicated validation clears (throughput, KV cache behavior, failover), we flip prod to Dedicated US-East on the target cut date 2026-07-12. Fallback plan: during the two-week cutover window Redwood will keep a short-lived Hosted pool for burst/fallback traffic; pricing for fallback is usage-based and we’ll include an escrowed capacity plan in the SOW.

> Compliance artifacts: our security team will need SOC2 evidence and an encrypted logging summary for vendor review.

We’ve attached SOC2 summary and will provide an encrypted logging sample. Karthik — I’ve asked the infra team to prepare the short compliance package (SOC2 excerpt + logging sample) by EOD 2026-06-02.

> Procurement timeline: we need a firm SOW + pricing by 2026-06-07 to hit our legal and finance cycles.

We will deliver an initial SOW draft and pricing matrix by 2026-06-04 and a signed-ready DocuSign by 2026-06-07 if approvals move as planned.

Proposed MAP action items (owners and dates):
- Redwood to provide Dedicated perf baseline and failover playbook — owner: Karthik — due 2026-06-09
- Compliance package (SOC2 excerpt + logging sample) — owner: Karthik — due 2026-06-02
- SOW draft + pricing — owner: Priyom — due 2026-06-04
- Tech deep-dive (30m) for MedNova infra team — owner: Soojin — proposed slot 2026-06-03 10:00 PT
- Final signoff / DocuSign target — 2026-06-07

I’ll prepare the SOW template and include the contingency pricing for fallback Hosted capacity. If any of the internal Redwood folks see missing risk items, flag them here.

Thanks — I’ll push the SOW and a one-pager on the fallback model shortly.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and hosting questions ahead of MOPC

Looping in a few technical constraints and an internal check:

- If MedNova plans to pass PHI through Redwood inference endpoints, Dedicated is the safest express lane. Private (VPC/on-prem) is only required if MedNova mandates full customer-controlled hardware or specific on-prem HSM usage; otherwise Dedicated + proper KMS integration and contractual controls works.
- For the Dedicated baseline we need to validate cold-start latency at 8k token sessions and KV cache warmup over 2 hours of steady traffic; we’ll run a 48-hour soak as part of validation. If the soak shows >10% latency degradation we will propose tuning (different instance shapes or quantization profile).
- Logging / audit: we can produce an encrypted log extract but MedNova engineering must confirm retention window and the format required for ingest into their SIEM (we prefer JSONL over syslog).

I’ll prepare the perf validation checklist and send to Ava + Sam by EOD along with a short test harness doc. Recommended tech deep-dive topics (for 2026-06-03 10:00 PT): network egress patterns, KV cache accounting, failover routing, and encryption-at-rest flow.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving & Runtime, Redwood Inference

From: Ava Patel <ava.patel@mednova.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Li <sam.li@mednova.com>, procurement@mednova.com
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and hosting questions ahead of MOPC

Thanks Priyom and Karthik — that plan looks reasonable. A few clarifications from procurement & infra: 

- Procurement: we can accept the SOW timeline as long as pricing is not materially higher than the estimate in the MAP. We still need an explicit fallback fee schedule for hosted-burst capacity while Dedicated autoscaling ramps.
- Infra (Sam): the SIEM expects JSONL exports; retention window initial ask is 90 days with the option to extend. If Redwood can provide a sample encrypted JSONL and estimated egress cost, we can sign off faster.

We’ll proceed with the POC on Hosted starting 2026-06-08 and schedule the tech deep-dive on 2026-06-03 10:00 PT as proposed. Assuming the Dedicated validation (2026-06-09 baseline) looks good, MedNova confirms target go-live for Dedicated prod on 2026-07-12. If we see blocking issues we may accept a temporary Hosted production lane with the negotiated fallback fees.

Procurement will be ready to review SOW draft on 2026-06-04. Please include the pricing matrix and an explicit DocuSign-ready SOW.

Best,
Ava

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ava Patel <ava.patel@mednova.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com, procurement@mednova.com
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and hosting questions ahead of MOPC — agreed MAP and next steps

Ava / Sam / procurement — summarizing agreed MAP items and next steps so we have a single source of truth. Quoting earlier thread for context.

Agreed high-level path:
- POC on Hosted: start 2026-06-08 (MedNova devs onboarded; Redwood provides Hosted endpoints and test tokens) — owner: Priyom — deliverable: POC checklist and onboarding notes.
- Dedicated validation sprint: window 2026-06-09 to 2026-06-21 — owner: Karthik — deliverable: perf baseline report, 48-hour soak, KV cache validation.
- Fallback model: short-lived Hosted pool kept during cutover window 2026-07-05 to 2026-07-19; explicit fallback pricing included in SOW — owner: Priyom — deliverable: fallback pricing matrix.
- Compliance artifacts delivered 2026-06-02 (SOC2 excerpt + encrypted JSONL sample) — owner: Karthik.
- SOW draft + pricing delivered 2026-06-04; DocuSign-ready by 2026-06-07 — owner: Priyom.

Attached: SOW_Redwood_MedNova_v1.docx (initial draft). DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABC-9981

If MedNova procurement can confirm that the fallback fee schedule is acceptable by 2026-06-07 we will reserve Dedicated capacity and target 2026-07-12 for production flip. If procurement needs a custom seat-based pricing variant we can include that as an alternate schedule in the SOW (please flag by 2026-06-05).

Ava — I’ll drop the SOW and the fallback pricing matrix into your shared Drive folder and send the DocuSign envelope once procurement confirms the preferred pricing schedule.

Thanks everyone — short checklist items are in the MAP workbook.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com
Attachments: SOW_Redwood_MedNova_v1.docx
